118993.note: The pin sits on the cabin's roof in its clearing, and the drawn road passes 10 m east of it.

234664.note: The pin is on open scrub with no building; the listing's own point, 490 m north, is in trees beside a cluster of six or more buildings on a drawn road, and nothing says which, if any, is the cabin.

234666.note: The pin sits on the drive among the cabin buildings, and the drawn road from the south ends 20 m from it.

234683.note: A metal-roofed cabin with a small shed stands 140 m southeast of the pin at the end of a dirt track that climbs from the drawn road, the only building in view; the pin was among scattered pinyon and now sits on the cabin.

10165110.note: The outline follows the strip between the highway and the river with its small loop and dirt spurs, and the point is inside it at the loop.

10165120.note: The outline holds a loop and the road toward the pond, plus a lot of forest along the river. The point is about 5 m outside it where the campground road leaves the highway.

10165140.note: The outline follows the spur road with pads under the trees between the river and the road, and the point is at its north tip where the spur begins.

10165145.note: The photo shows one campground, loops with pads on the lake's south shore, and the point is about 30 m south of it at a road junction. But OpenStreetMap names that outline Cottonwood Lake Campground, not Big Creek, so the map may be showing a different campground.

10165175.note: Unchanged. The pin is in open pine scrub crossed by dirt tracks south of Chalk Creek, with a few houses about 80 m north; no loop, pads or campers show anywhere within reach, so there was nothing to move it to.

10165190.note: There's no outline. The pin is among short dirt spurs with clearings and pull-ins off the main road, which reads as the campground.

10165210.note: The outline follows the campground's loops with pads, and the point is about 20 m north of it where the campground road leaves the main road.

10165230.note: The outline follows a spur with pads beside the road, and the point is inside it at the east end where the spur begins.

10165235.note: The outline holds a small meadow with a dirt track beside the pass's paved parking lot, which fits a three-site campground but shows no clear pads. The point is at the lot's edge, just outside it.

10165245.note: Moved the pin about 280 m south from the road junction east of the lake to the two loops OpenStreetMap names Cottonwood Lake Campground Road, where pads and a camper show in clearings among the spruce; the loops by the dam are the parking area. There's no outline, so the map shows the pin between the loops.

10165250.note: The outline holds a patch of forest with a road and a few clearings and vehicles, though the trees hide most pads. The point is about 10 m outside it, where its road meets the lakeside road.

10165260.note: The outline follows the winding campground road with clearings and pads, and the point is about 20 m outside it on the road in.

10165265.note: The outline holds the campground's two loops with pads under the trees, and the point is about 30 m west of it at the junction where the campground road leaves the main road.

10165290.note: The outline follows the spur road along the creek with pads under the trees, and the point is inside it at the west end where the road comes in.

10165300.note: The outline follows a loop with pads above the road, and the point is just outside it at the loop's entrance on the main road.

10165310.note: The outline follows a spur loop with pads, and the point is inside it at the corner where the spur leaves the road. Another loop with pads about 80 m north is left outside the outline.

10165315.note: OpenStreetMap outlines this campground as two small clusters about 450 m apart, and the map takes only the southern one, a small patch in the trees about 100 m from the point. The point is by a small road loop at the main road, so the map would show only part of the campground.

10165325.note: Unchanged. The pin is at a fork of dirt roads in pine forest; the spur running south from it passes a couple of parked vehicles under heavy canopy, but no loop, pads or tents show, so the photo doesn't plainly show the campground and nothing was moved.

10165340.note: The outline holds a meadow with a small loop road and a few vehicles and trailers. The point is about 50 m north of it, at the junction where the road to it leaves the main road.

10165345.note: Unchanged. The pin is already at the pull-out where the lanes OpenStreetMap names Handcart Campground Road leave Hall Valley Road, with four vehicles parked; the lanes run into full canopy and no pads or tents show, so the photo doesn't plainly show the campground (Hall Valley's outlined loop is 470 m west) and there was nothing better to move it to.

10165355.note: There's no outline. The pin is on a road with pull-ins and a parked vehicle under the trees, ending in a small loop with a structure about 100 m west, which reads as a small campground.

10165400.note: There's no outline. The pin is inside a small loop road with pads off the main road, which reads as the campground.

10165405.note: Moved the pin about 115 m west along the lane OpenStreetMap names Lake Creek Campground Road to its middle, where campers sit in pull-outs among the trees (one more 70 m further west). There's no outline and the trees hide most pads, so the map shows the pin on the lane.

10165410.note: The outline follows the lakeshore strip with its loops and pads, and the point is inside it.

10165425.note: The outline follows the campground's loops and spurs with pads, and the point is at its west tip where the road comes in.

10165445.note: There's no outline. The pin is at the junction where a loop with pads and parked trailers leaves the road, just south of the loop.

10165450.note: The outline holds the end loop with pads and the spur road to it, and the point is about 10 m outside its northwest tip, where the spur leaves the main road.

10165460.note: There's no outline. The pin is among small road loops with pads and campers beside a gravel lot near the reservoir, which plainly reads as a campground.

10165480.note: The outline holds the loop with pads in the trees above the reservoir, and the point is about 10 m outside it on the main road at the loop's entrance.

10165500.note: The nearest outline is a strip between the highway and the river that OpenStreetMap names Granite Tent Campground, about 110 m from the point across the highway. The map would show a different campground.

10165505.note: There's no outline. The pin is inside a road loop under the trees by the reservoir, with a few clearings along it, which reads as the campground loop.

10165545.note: The outline holds the loop with pads and parked trailers, plus a large stretch of forest to the west. The point is inside it on the road in.

10165550.note: The outline holds a long loop with pads and campers in the trees south of the road. The point is about 90 m northwest of it on the main road, beside a building near the spur that leads in.

10165555.note: Moved the pin about 130 m south from the highway junction to the end of the Platte River Campground Road parking strip, with tents plainly showing among the trees between it and the river (the listing says tent camping only). There's no outline, so the map shows the pin there.

10165571.note: The outline follows the campground's loops with pads, and the point is at its west edge where the road comes in.

10165576.note: The outline follows the gravel loops and spurs by the river, and the point is about 80 m east of it where the campground road leaves the highway.

10165616.note: There's no outline. The pin is at the junction where a loop with pads and a parked vehicle leaves the road, so it sits at a campground's entrance.

10165641.note: The outline holds the campground's loops with pads and campers, and the point is about 10 m outside it where the campground road meets the main road.

10165651.note: The outline holds the loop with pads and campers beside the creek, and the point is inside it at the south end on the road in.

10165666.note: The outline holds the loop and spur with pads, and the point is about 10 m outside it where the spur leaves the road.

10165676.note: The outline holds a loop road through dense trees, where only a few clearings show. The point is about 95 m north of it on the highway, where the road to it turns off.

10165681.note: The outline holds the campground's loop with pads and campers. The point is about 40 m east of it, at a pull-out on the highway.

10165701.note: The outline holds the campground's loops with pads, and the point is inside it.

10165711.note: There's no outline. The pin is where a road leaves the highway toward spurs with pads and parked vehicles along the river, so it sits at a campground's entrance.

10165726.note: The outline is a long strip along the lakeshore road that holds pads at its southwest end and a loop at its northeast end, with a stretch of plain road between. The point is about 10 m outside its northeast end on the road.

10165731.note: The outline holds the loop with pads and campers on the neck between the two lakes, and the point is inside it.

10165736.note: Moved the pin about 140 m northwest from the entrance junction to the middle of the lane OpenStreetMap names Weston Pass Campground Road, between a parked camper and the small loop at its end, with pale pull-outs along both. There's no outline, so the map shows the pin on the lane.

10165746.note: The outline holds the loop with pads and trailers, and the point is about 55 m east of it where the campground road leaves the main road.

10165751.note: The outline follows the campground's loops with pads, and the point is about 20 m outside it at the junction where the road comes in.
